headline.en: Large street-facing windows with great light

traits.zh: 整面落地玻璃窗，采光充足，可看到外侧树木
traits.en: Full-height glass window with ample natural light and view of trees outside

traits.zh: 提供埃塞俄比亚孔加、罕贝拉等单一产地咖啡豆
traits.en: Offers single-origin beans like Ethiopia Konga and Hambella

traits.zh: 招牌饮品使用100% Arabica咖啡豆制作浓缩基底
traits.en: Signature drink uses 100% Arabica espresso base

traits.zh: 以站立吧台为主，配高脚凳，空间紧凑
traits.en: Primarily standing bar with high stools, compact space

traits.zh: 营业至晚18:30，工作日早7:30开门
traits.en: Opens at 7:30 AM, closes at 6:30 PM on weekends

linger.en: Small space, designed for quick visits

adventure.zh: 单一产地豆但无手冲/自烘信息
adventure.en: Single-origin beans, no experimental drinks noted
